name: OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API: walking and cycling

measures.definition: Share of residential streets within 5 km of the centre whose middle has a food shop, a pharmacy or doctor, a school, a park and a public-transport stop each within 1 km as the crow flies.
Kilometres of cycle paths plus roads with a separate cycle track tagged on them, within 10 km of the centre, per km² of land there; painted lanes are not counted.

coverage.period: the OpenStreetMap state on the day it is read

rights.edition: OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API, read 2026-11-05

fetch.rateLimit: public Overpass servers: two slots per client, under 10,000 queries a day; two queries of about a minute and a half a place

vetted.notes: Share-alike: kept apart and credited. Not run from a browser (cors false here by choice): the queries are too heavy to send from every visitor's page.

caveats: Counts measure how thoroughly a city is mapped as well as what exists; OSM is strongest in Europe.
Straight-line distance: a river or a motorway without a crossing makes a real walk longer.
Doctors' surgeries are mapped unevenly, so a pharmacy counts as well.
